### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **14** documentable anchor(s).

**7** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class), saveMetaItem (symbol, a method of class ObjectStackProtocolImplementation), /api/v1/meta/view/:name (route, a path literal in semantic; a path literal in surface))_
- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`  _(via saveMetaItem (symbol, a method of class ObjectStackProtocolImplementation))_
- `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx`  _(via saveMetaItem (symbol, a method of class ObjectStackProtocolImplementation))_
- `content/docs/kernel/services-checklist.mdx`  _(via saveMetaItem (symbol, a method of class ObjectStackProtocolImplementation), /api/v1/meta/view/:name (route, a path literal in semantic; a path literal in surface))_
- `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx`  _(via saveMetaItem (symbol, a method of class ObjectStackProtocolImplementation))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/index.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/meta/view/:name (route, a path literal in semantic; a path literal in surface))_
- `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/meta/view/:name (route, a path literal in semantic; a path literal in surface))_

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **138** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 72f8c3820154c69cdf9faa6f887dc544e4c4b823` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `3c9bd02f49c574bd820e35ed9bcb41e4a3097829` — the merge of head `9924c95b0b603c34729ac2706d48b6bb7d7ff24b` into base `72f8c3820154c69cdf9faa6f887dc544e4c4b823`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 3c9bd02f49c574bd820e35ed9bcb41e4a3097829 && git checkout 3c9bd02f49c574bd820e35ed9bcb41e4a3097829
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 72f8c3820154c69cdf9faa6f887dc544e4c4b823 9924c95b0b603c34729ac2706d48b6bb7d7ff24b && git checkout -B drift-repro 72f8c3820154c69cdf9faa6f887dc544e4c4b823 && git merge --no-ff 9924c95b0b603c34729ac2706d48b6bb7d7ff24b

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 72f8c3820154c69cdf9faa6f887dc544e4c4b823
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 72f8c3820154c69cdf9faa6f887dc544e4c4b823` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `9924c95b0b603c34729ac2706d48b6bb7d7ff24b`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #20051 (body and all 26 comments, rulings 甲 `5856781584` / `5856866699`, the maintainer's record `5909085121` 「20051 不考虑现有的数据」, the director's ruling `5910106571` on Q2 = B / Q1 = A / Q3 = A, the dev's reports `5909437934`, `5912512351`, `5912995677`); PR #20868 body, its 19-file list, and `git diff origin/main...` at this head; the check-runs on this head. Claims verified against `origin/main` (ADR-0005 appendix (c) at `docs/adr/0005-metadata-customization-overlay.md:312`, ADR-0087 addendum 2026-08-01b at `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md:506`, `VIEW_CONSOLE_ROUND_TRIP_KEYS` at `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:6260`, the flow branch of `saveMetaItem` at `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:16738`) and against objectui at the pin `db11afd4967c` (`runtime-metadata-persistence.ts` `viewEnvelope`, `ObjectView.tsx` `buildPersistedViewBody` / `VIEW_ROW_STATE_KEYS` / `getListViewConfigKeys`, `data-objectstack/src/index.ts` `viewItemObjectName` and the `listViews` flatten).

Check-runs on this head, read 2026-09-30T14:18Z: 35 runs. 32 `success`, 2 `skipped` (Console Pin Gate: no `.objectui-sha` move; Packed-tarball smoke: opt-in), 1 `in_progress`: Lint and Repo Gates. Test Core (all six shards and the aggregate), Build Core, Build Docs, the four Type Check jobs, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Spec property liveness, Dogfood gates and Temporal Conformance all read `success`. The runs on `41913270` were cancelled by the push and are not counted. Landing waits for the one run still in progress to read green.

### ① Derived judgments

1. `@objectstack/spec` accept set NARROWED: `ViewItemWireSchema`, both arms, gains `options: z.never({ error }).optional()` through `viewItemWireFields()`, which is spread into exactly the two arms (`view.zod.ts:5324`, `:5328` on the branch) and nowhere else. A ViewItem record (`{ name, object, viewKind, config }`) carrying a top-level `options` is now refused at path `options` with the curated prescription (move each `options.KIND` to `config.KIND`); an absent key still parses. The narrowing reaches `VIEW_METADATA_MEMBERS.viewItem`, the `viewItem` branch of `ViewMetadataSchema`, the published `ViewItemWire.json` (`not: {}`), the `ViewItemWire` type (`options?: never`) and the two regenerated rows in `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx`. RIGHT: Q3 = A as ruled and as the seat answered (`5909486308`). Verified at the pin that no console write puts the bag on a record: `viewEnvelope` returns `{ name, object, viewKind: 'list', label, config }`, the config-save filters keys to `SpecListViewSchema.shape` plus `VIEW_ROW_STATE_KEYS`, and the whole-tab toolbar write is the FLAT overlay shape (no `config`), judged by `listOverlay`, not by this member. The list overlay's `options: ListViewOverlayOptionsSchema` (`:6181`) and the form overlay's `z.undefined()` refusal (`:6213`) are untouched, so the door half (PR #20183) and objectui's `options.map` pin stand. `z.never` over the form overlay's `z.undefined` is RIGHT for a member published on its own as JSON Schema (`undefined` has no JSON Schema form; Build Core is green on this head, which is where "a previously published schema disappeared" would have refused).

2. `@objectstack/spec` public surface WIDENED, registry only: one new step-18 semantic entry `view-item-options-bag-refused` (`entries/semantic/18.view-item-options-bag-refused.ts` plus the generated region of `registry.ts`). RIGHT: ruling 甲 item 4 requires the ADR-0087 disposition; a semantic (D3) entry rather than a conversion is right because which of two spellings of one block the author meant is not mechanical; step 18 matches the `18.ui__ViewItemWire__owner` / `__hidden` retired-key entries already in the tree (spec is at 17.5.0). The changeset's marker `adr-0087: registered view-item-options-bag-refused` names it. Its strings carry no tracker number.

3. `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` stored shape CHANGED for `view` only; the door's accept set is unchanged (same `schema.safeParse` gate, same 422 envelope). `saveMetaItem` now stores `projectStorableViewBody(request.item, parsed.data, reparse)` when `singularType === 'view'`: the parsed value of every key the body carried, undeclared keys dropped, schema defaults not materialised, moved keys under their canonical spelling (`groups` to `sections`, `visibleOn` to `visibleWhen`), `sort[].id` dropped (it is stripped inside the parse preprocess at `view.zod.ts:6682`, so the projection sees it as a key the parse did not keep). RIGHT under letter B (`5910106571`): views join the rule ADR-0087 addendum 2026-08-01b records for flows ("`storable` excludes schema defaults, and this is load-bearing"), and the gate mirrors the existing `singularType === 'flow'` branch. Every other type keeps request body plus the two grafts plus the page `type` default. RIGHT: the ruling names views; `ViewFilterRuleSchema` and `FormViewSchema` are reused by page, component, skill, sharing and field schemas, so the grafts still have consumers, and widening the projection to `dashboard` and the rest is its own decision (noted in the PR's acceptance notes, as Prime Directive #10 asks).

4. `projectStorableViewBody` is exported from `protocol.ts` for its sibling test but is NOT re-exported from `packages/metadata-protocol/src/index.ts` (verified on the branch), so the package's public entry does not widen; no `api-surface` artifact tracks it. The helper's own invariant is the right one: the stored body must re-parse to exactly the save's parse (a GET then PUT is judged the same), bounded at 8 rounds, key-move detection by re-parse evidence rather than a hand list. The `converged: false` fail-safe stores `parsed.data` whole and warns once per `type|name`. Log level judged against AGENTS.md "Degradation log levels": after the fallback, everything the author wrote has landed (normalised) and the row is served as stored, so the system is not "looking normal while a claimed persist did not land"; this is a functional degradation (that row's defaults pinned), `warn` is RIGHT, and it is an `if` arm rather than a `catch` around a durability callee, so `check:durability-log-level` owes nothing. The message states consequence and fix and carries no tracker number. Unreachable by today's `view` schema; pinned through the production seam `registerMetadataTypeSchema('view', …)` with the built-in restored in `finally`.

5. objectui consequences at the pin, derived from the diff: console-written keys that no longer reach a stored row are `sort[].id` (W1, W7), and a top-level `id` and `objectName` (W6b, the whole-tab toolbar write). Every reader falls back: `viewItemObjectName` reads `data.object`, then `object`, then `objectName`; `viewRowId` prefers `name`; the sort and filter builders mint a fresh row id. `object` is present on the W6b body because `normalizeViewMetadata` runs with the registry baseline before the parse. The five row-state keys the console writes (`isDefault`, `isPinned`, `sortOrder`, `visibility`, `columnState`) and `_isOverride` are each declared in `VIEW_CONSOLE_ROUND_TRIP_KEYS` and kept; the re-judged list-overlay GUARD asserts every key that record maps to `listOverlay`. RIGHT: Q1 = A as ruled; nothing the console reads back is lost. Console Pin Gate skipped correctly (no pin move) and no objectui change is owed for this landing.

6. Pins, each read in the diff: the three verbatim-save pins re-judged rather than flipped (graft-folded coexistence and GUARD moved from a form overlay, where the keys are undeclared, to the list overlay; protocol-meta "preserves Studio-only auxiliary fields verbatim" now asserts the declared keys stored and `objectName` dropped with `object` carrying the binding); publish-rollback (`rowHeight` declared, `extra` never reaches a version) and view-identity-overlay (sort row id not stored); the ruling's named pins (W1 to W5 store no `type`; form stores no `sharing.enabled` and no section defaults; undeclared key dropped; declared key keeps its normalised value); nested moved key; parse-equivalence over toolbar, flat form, record and container bodies; the record `options` refusal on both arms with envelope `code`, `status`, path, message and zero rows written; the page control; the helper's arms (a) to (d) driven directly; the warn dedupe. The card body's three pins hold: the direct and wrapped refusal and the `options.map` round-trip are the door half's, on `main`; "the persisted body equals the parse result" is, under letter B, the parse-equivalence pin. `view-union-retirement-prescription` §2 admits a closed two-entry pinned-absent family, each entry required to be reached and to match its curated text, so the never-leaf population stays lit. RIGHT.

7. Comment-only re-citations from "ADR-0005 §Validation" (a heading the ADR does not have) to "ADR-0005 appendix (c)" in `protocol.ts` and `view.zod.ts`, and `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__metadata-protocol__src__protocol.ts.json` gaining ADR-0005 and ADR-0087 with the stage (iv) invariant. RIGHT: the code cites what the ADR says (Prime Directive #13). No `docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md` or `CLAUDE.md` path is in the file list, so this is not a governed diff; the Governed Surface Queue Guard reads `success`. The at-tier record is owed by the path limb (`packages/spec/src/**` non-test), and this is it.

8. Generated artifacts: `view.mdx` regenerated and in the diff; JSON schemas and the api surface are build outputs, not tracked (verified by `git ls-tree`); `registry.ts`'s generated region is in the diff beside its entry. Build Core and Build Docs read `success` on this head.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/20051-persist-parsed-view-body.md`: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol: minor`, `@objectstack/spec: minor`, `**BREAKING**` banner, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, one `adr-0087: registered …` marker, a FROM to TO table, the one-line fix, and an existing-rows section quoting the maintainer verbatim. It matches what the diff publishes: spec narrows a wire accept set and adds a registry entry; metadata-protocol changes what a view save stores. The level is RIGHT under ADR-0087's launch-window section as amended 2026-09-13: "Pre-GA, a metadata-facing retirement or break ships `minor`, carrying the `**BREAKING**` banner and its ADR-0087 disposition entry", which is also how ruling 甲 item 4 spells stage (iv). `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/lint` change tests only and publish nothing, so no changeset is owed for them. `check-adr-0087-registration` reads the arm from the changeset (`readClause2Line(parsed.body)`), and Check Changeset reads `success` on this head.

`Clause-②:` line: the PR body carries `Clause-②: no`, the changeset carries `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`. Judged: not a conflict. The value is `no` in both and is truthful (nothing widens the accept set; the one new function is not on the package entry; the registry entry is the disposition the narrowing owes), the arm is optional per AGENTS.md Post-Task item 3, and it sits in the one text the gate that reads arms reads. The widening-tells gate recognises `z.never(` as a refusing value opener (`REFUSING_RETURN`), so the added `options` key line declines T1 rather than firing under `no`.

### ③ Boundary flags

Every dev flag and every `open_questions` entry, answered:

- Q1, Q2, Q3 of `5909437934`: answered by the director's ruling `5910106571` (B; A; A) and implemented as ruled; `open_questions: []` in both final reports.
- Clause-② spelling (`no` on the PR, `no (narrowing)` in the changeset): answered above, not a conflict.
- Moved keys found by re-parse evidence rather than a named list: RIGHT within ruling B's "one projection replacing two grafts"; the convergence invariant, not the detector, is what the stored row is held to, and it is pinned. One corner named for the seat, not blocking: when a moved container has a dropped sibling key of the same shape (`soleMovedFrom` finds more than one candidate), the moved value is stored whole, so that container's nested defaults are pinned although the row still re-parses to the parse. No console write at the pin produces that shape. Carrier: the next change to `projectStorableViewBody`; a pin for that corner would close it.
- The fail-safe arm stores `parsed.data` whole; ablation 2 on this card showed that for a column-less toolbar patch that shape is refused on re-save ("sets `type` but lists no `columns`"), so the warning's "re-save the view" prescription could itself be refused in that arm. Loud to the caller (a 422), unreachable today, pinned. Noted, not blocking.
- `z.never()` rather than `z.undefined()` and the re-judge of the retirement-prescription population: RIGHT, see ① 1 and 6.
- File surface beyond the claim line (migrations entry and regenerated registry, `view.mdx`, spec tests, objectql pins, comment-only test headers): each is either what ruling 甲 item 4 requires, what Post-Task item 5 requires, or a pin the sweep found; none is scope growth.
- Process notes (a JS-only closure build repaired before typecheck, one single-file run re-run under the lock, the `origin/main` merge via `os-regen-merge.sh`, the shared `.git` deepened for the engine-split gate, no dogfood reading owed, a test block moved and strengthened in the patch round, the warn-dedupe pin riding the graft-folded file's engine double): nothing committed from an unclean state; no action owed.
- Out-of-scope findings: other types stay verbatim (carrier none, noted in the PR; the ruling names views); the objectui `listViews` flatten drops `isPinned` / `sortOrder` / `visibility` / `columnState` before the whole-tab write (present today, independent of this PR, carrier objectui#11013, code read only); stale "§Validation" citations in files this PR does not touch (carrier: the next change to those files). Each has a named carrier or is prose only; consistent with Prime Directive #10.
- Docs follow-up: ADR-0005's Status line, the "Ruled, not yet in force" marker and the `parsed.data` bullet go stale the moment this lands, until the seat's separate Tier H PR for the maintainer's hand. That sequencing is what ruling `5910106571` prescribes; no `docs/adr/**` edit here is right.
- The stored-row census: waived by the maintainer (`5909085121`), so it is not a landing gate for this PR; a stored record carrying a top-level `options` is served as stored and refused only on its next save, which the changeset and the D3 entry both say.
- Not escalated: nothing here needs the maintainer's word beyond what the three rulings already gave.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-20051-persist-parsed-view-body`
Reviewed-by: `session_018fxqvRJW12TaHC7DUQ89Y6`

**VERDICT: PASS**
